description: Li₂NaK(SO₄)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.72-3.16 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.74 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.01 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Li-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.49 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one K, one Li, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Li, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Li, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Li, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, two Li, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Li, and one S atom.
